$description: Comment design preview tokens (stage 1). Decided by the Design System Lead on 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-22 (B146): organism; the closed comment is a marker, the Avatar medium (space.32) of the author of the first message; the open comment is a bubble to the right of the marker, aligned on its top edge (it flips to the left, or upward, near the edge of the canvas), background.page + shadow.dropdown + radius.8, no border, width size.dialog-small (400px), height following the thread up to 100% of the visible canvas (the thread scrolls); header with the Resolve and Close IconButtons tertiary on the right and nothing on the left (Resolve becomes Reopen, icon undo, on a resolved comment); thread of CommentMessage; reply field always visible at the bottom with a primary send IconButton; selected = ring (border.focus, border-width.2, offset space.8) around the marker; resolved = the marker shows the icon check instead of the initials, at full opacity (accessibility audit B146-2: opacity.disabled left the marker below 3:1). The marker is a button: hover and pressed = state layers in the content color, focus = ring (border.focus, border-width.2, offset space.4, accessibility audit B146-2: offset space.0 left the ring the same color as the marker). The gap between the marker and the bubble is space.16, so that the ring of the selected state (offset space.8 + 2px) does not touch the bubble. Values proposed in the preview (ring, bubble padding, gaps, header icon color) confirmed by the Design System Lead on 2026-11-22. Variants are the states of the comment: closed, open, selected, resolved, editing; the marker states (hover, focus, pressed) are shown in the state row.
text: Could the primary button be full width on mobile?

header-gap.description: Space between the Resolve and Close buttons (proposal)

ring.description: Ring of the selected comment, around the marker

ring-offset.description: Space between the marker and the ring of the selected comment

focus-offset.description: Space between the marker and its focus ring
